responds_to: Independent review of rev1 (scope 10c2b225) which found two MATERIAL bugs via quantitative checks; rev2 fixes both. The rev2 focused recheck binds to scope 4a150871 + audit 2a842a0e.

responses.title: Readout source-weight scaling (C inflated by S*n=2816)
responses.reviewer_evidence: fit_readout put w_c=1/(S*n_c) on BOTH Kronecker factors (GPhi_c AND GQ_c). Normal matrix K=kron(GPhi_c,GQ_c) carried w_c^2, so the solved C was inflated by 1/w_c=S*n=2816. Reviewer measured C_code/C_correct=2816 exactly, DEV MSE ~19308 vs ~0.012, grad_rel_at_C_code=73 vs 1.6e-14 at the true optimum.
responses.fix: v4_repr.py fit_readout: source weight appears ONCE, on GPhi_c only (gphi = w*(phi.T@phi)); GQ_c = q.T@(g2[:,None]*q) is UNWEIGHTED. The Kronecker normal matrix now carries w_c exactly once. v4_repr.py 409287ae -> 8ead06e5caac5beea46800d0b3dff2ea3c4c17a2996371591cee8570ecb55257.
responses.verification: Strengthened smoke 162978 PASS 14/14: readout DEV MSE/Q1 ratios now EXACTLY match the reviewer's independently computed correct values (L32 1.1790, DELTA_N32 1.1678, ENDPOINT_N32 1.1565, L64_Q32 1.1294 at high04/256; floor_mse 0.00948). Added smoke check readout_mse_sane_vs_Q1 (each repr DEV MSE/Q1 < 100) which catches the S*n scaling class. Gradient at the solved C is ~1e-14 (true optimum), not ~73.

responses.title: cal_numerical_floor BF16 dtype crash
responses.reviewer_evidence: cal_numerical_floor called bf16_replay with fp32 u0 x bf16 a -> RuntimeError (dtype mismatch in u0@a). The rev1 smoke never exercised run()'s floor path, so the crash slipped past smoke and only appeared in the reviewer's full run.
responses.fix: v4_runner.py cal_numerical_floor: cast u0/u1/y0/y1 to .bfloat16() and gate to .float() before bf16_replay, reproducing the deployed BF16 cache/gate rounding (u0@a requires matching bf16 dtype; gate fp32 for base.float()*g promotion). v4_runner.py f95237ee -> 9c6d8940524aa7feb11a1f047ee94824e24e7698a64de8cf98da856298739e35.
responses.verification: Added smoke check cal_floor_finite which calls V.cal_numerical_floor directly (exercises the floor path); smoke 162978 PASS 14/14 with finite floor. The full V4 run calls cal_numerical_floor for every config and completes (definitive test in the rev2 recheck).
